title: scrollable settings screen
description:
Owner finding 2026-11-14: "settings'te scroll edilmiyor, ekran dolmuş"
— the Settings body did not scroll and the screen was full, so the
bottom rows were unreachable. The stats-readback toggle row was
tappable where it peeked on screen but its supporting text was
unreadable, and on tighter layouts the whole row (plus the Measure
action) was clipped off-screen entirely.

Root cause: the body is a fixed Column with no scroll modifier. As rows
were added over time (preview quality, render backend, gyro folder,
device report, Measure, the stats-readback toggle), the content
outgrew the screen and nothing could reach the tail.

Fix (minimal, preserving the design):
- The body Column gains .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()) — the
  exact modifier pattern the screen already used for the codec-report
  FlowRow in the device dialog. Every row is now reachable on any
